parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id,
  l.short_id,
  l.en_title,
  l.ar_title,
  l.price,
  l.area_sqm,
  l.bedrooms,
  l.bathrooms,
  l.city,
  l.district,
  l.type,
  l.completion_status,
  l.en_description,
  l.project_id,
  p.name_en  AS project_name_en,
  p.name_ar  AS project_name_ar
FROM listings l
LEFT JOIN projects p ON l.project_id = p.id
WHERE l.id = '{{ $('Extract & Validate Input').first().json.entityUuid }}'::uuid
  AND l.status = 'ACTIVE'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  id AS project_id,
  name_en,
  name_ar,
  description_en,
  city,
  district,
  completion_status,
  expected_delivery,
  total_units
FROM projects
WHERE id = '{{ $('Extract & Validate Input').first().json.entityUuid }}'::uuid
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  en_title AS title,
  price,
  area_sqm,
  bedrooms,
  bathrooms,
  completion_status,
  type
FROM listings
WHERE project_id = '{{ $('Extract & Validate Input').first().json.entityUuid }}'::uuid
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY price ASC;

INSERT INTO crm_leads (
  source, name, phone, email, status,
  property_interest, city_preference,
  campaign_details, is_duplicate,
  created_at, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  'META_ADS',
  '{{ $json.sqlLeadName }}',
  '{{ $json.sqlPhone }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.sqlEmail }}', ''),
  'NEW',
  '{{ $json.sqlPropertyName }}',
  '{{ $json.sqlPropertyCity }}',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'ad_type',          '{{ $json.sqlAdType }}',
    'entity_uuid',      '{{ $json.entityUuid }}',
    'property_name',    '{{ $json.sqlPropertyName }}',
    'price_range',      '{{ $json.sqlPriceRange }}',
    'country',          '{{ $json.sqlCountry }}',
    'timezone',         '{{ $json.sqlTimezone }}',
    'source',           'VAPI_VOICE_QUALIFICATION',
    'call_initiated_at', NOW()::text
  ),
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_leads WHERE phone = '{{ $json.sqlPhone }}'),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

UPDATE crm_leads SET
  status = 'AI_ATTEMPTING',
  campaign_details = campaign_details || jsonb_build_object(
    'vapi_call_id',     '{{ $json.id }}',
    'vapi_call_status', 'initiated',
    'call_started_at',  NOW()::text
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('Merge Context + CRM ID').first().json.crmLeadId }}'::uuid;

UPDATE crm_leads SET
  status     = 'AI_QUALIFIED',
